description: Let an agent tell you what it found while it is still working, not only in the message that ends its turn. Agents get a `flare` tool and send a finding, a decision, a progress or status update, a blocker or a summary; the newest one shows in a banner above the message box, and the thread's Flares tab keeps them all, drawn the way bb draws a reply, so an agent can answer with a chart, a diagram, a table or a snippet instead of describing it. Blockers, and flares the agent marks urgent, send a push notification, so alerts reach you while the work carries on. A child thread's flares appear in its parent's tab, and a child's blocker reaches the parent's agent as a note without starting a turn. The tool returns at once, so the agent never waits, and `bb flare send` works from a terminal or another agent.
